subject: Q3 kickoff: owner commitments, gate checklist, and sign-off
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Q3 kickoff: owner commitments, gate checklist, and sign-off

Team —

Thanks for jumping on this early. Attached is the first draft of the Q3 OKR compact and a short gate checklist I want owners to acknowledge before we publish the slate. Goal is to have this signed by leadership and the org by end of week (EOD Wed 7/16) so the team can start sprint planning next week.

High-level proposed OKRs (summary):
- Objective A: Improve inference unit economics (owner: Marcus)
  - KR1: Reduce avg cost-per-token by 18% vs Q2 baseline
  - KR2: Ship two batching/quantization playbooks with A/B results measured
- Objective B: Increase platform reliability for critical routes (owner: Kimberly)
  - KR1: P95 latency target met across 3/4 of high-frequency routes
  - KR2: Reduce incident MTTR by 30% vs Q2
- Objective C: Developer adoption and self-service (owner: Tessa)
  - KR1: 20% increase in active API projects using Dedicated/private features
  - KR2: Publish 3 reference templates + onboarding flows

Gate checklist for owner sign-off (attached):
1) Clearly defined metrics and measurement plan
2) Dedicated owner and alternate owner listed
3) Risk register with mitigation and clear go/no-go thresholds
4) Required cross-team dependencies confirmed
5) QBR artifact owners identified

Ask: please review the attached compact and reply with either:
- "ACK" if you accept the owner assignment and gate criteria, or
- an inline change request (short bullets) if you propose edits.

If I don't hear from you by EOD 7/16 I will assume implicit acceptance and lock the slate at 9am Thu 7/17 for QBR prep.

Attachment: Q3_OKR_compact_v1.xlsx (master compact + measurement sheet)

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Q3 kickoff: owner commitments, gate checklist, and sign-off

Vanessa —

Thanks for the draft. I made a few inline edits (attached) and one substantive suggestion below.

On Objective B / KR1: P95 latency target — I recommend we scope this to the top 10 routes by token volume rather than 3/4 of high-frequency routes. That gives us a deterministic measurement set for SLO reporting. Also adding an owner for observability (I proposed Aditya as backup on the sheet).

Small asks:
- Add a short definition of "high-frequency route" in the measurement sheet (I put a note in column H).
- For the MTTR goal, can we align on whether we include infra-only incidents or platform+infra? I propose platform-only to start.

I've attached the compact with my comments: Q3_OKR_compact_v1-kp-comments.xlsx

Onwards —
Kimberly Park
Director, Site Reliability Engineering
Redwood Inference

Quick flag from capacity planning —

The cost-per-token reduction target (18%) assumes both a successful quantization effort and a 12% throughput improvement from batching. Current hiring timelines mean we won't have the additional engineering capacity until mid-August, which risks delivery cadence for the playbooks.

Proposal:
- Keep the 18% aspirational target in the OKR but add a gated milestone: 8% expected progress by end of August; full 18% only if the mid-August hires come in and we validate the batch kernel.
- I'll own a short risk log and a fallback threshold (if we miss 8% by 8/31 we'll shift the playbook timeline and present a mitigation plan at the Sept QBR). See attached owner_risk_log.pdf for details.

Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Director, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

Thanks all — appreciate the quick turn. Final decisions below and next steps.

Decisions (locked as of 16:00 PT 7/17):
- Owners: Marcus (Objective A), Kimberly (Objective B), Tessa (Objective C). Backups: Aditya (observability), Naomi (product metrics).
- Measurement: use Top-10 routes by token volume for the P95 latency SLO; MTTR scope = platform-only incidents.
- Cost KR: keep 18% aspirational; add gated milestone (8% by 31-Aug). Marcus will own the risk log and mitigation cadence.
- Gate checklist: add risk-acceptance column and explicit artifact owners (Hannah will verify with facilitator).

Action items (short):
1) Marcus: finalize owner_risk_log.pdf and share weekly updates starting 7/25 (Owner)
2) Kimberly: update measurement sheet to define Top-10 routes + confirm Aditya backup (Due: 7/20)
3) Tessa: draft onboarding templates and list of 3 reference apps (Due: 7/28)
4) Hannah: confirm QBR artifact readiness with facilitator and send calendar invite for the artifact review (Due: 7/22)
5) Vanessa: publish locked OKR compact and create the QBR artifact folder (Done by 7/18)

I attached the final gated owner commitments doc. If there are objections, escalate to me by EOD Fri 7/18; otherwise I will publish the compact on Mon 7/21 and kick off the QBR packet workstream.

Attachment: Gated_owner_commitments.docx

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
